evals.name: Strict TypeScript Configuration & Zero any Enforcement
evals.prompt: Configure a production tsconfig.json with strict compiler checks, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, and verify that any explicit any annotations are prohibited.
evals.expected_output: Configures strict compiler flags in tsconfig.json, rejects explicit any types, and applies unknown with type narrowing.
assertions: Enables strict mode in TypeScript compiler configuration
Enables noImplicitAny and strictNullChecks to eliminate unhandled nullability bugs
Enforces replacement of explicit any types with unknown or specific interfaces
Ensures compiler does not allow silent type-checking bypasses

evals.name: Staged Pre-Commit Quality Gate with Husky & lint-staged
evals.prompt: Set up a pre-commit hook using Husky and lint-staged to run ESLint autofix, Prettier formatting, and type-checking on staged files before commit creation.
evals.expected_output: Initializes Husky pre-commit hook executing lint-staged on modified files with ESLint, Prettier, and tsc typecheck.
assertions: Installs and configures Husky pre-commit hook script
Restricts linter and formatter execution to git staged files via lint-staged
Rejects git commits containing unresolvable linter errors or formatting deviations
Guarantees sub-second pre-commit feedback loops for developer velocity

evals.name: Conventional Commits Enforcement & Pre-Commit Secret Scanning
evals.prompt: Configure commitlint with Conventional Commits 1.0.0 rules via commit-msg hook, and integrate GitLeaks to block commits containing hardcoded credentials.
evals.expected_output: Sets up commitlint.config.js with conventional types, configures .husky/commit-msg, and adds GitLeaks protect to pre-commit hook.
assertions: Validates commit header syntax according to <type>(<scope>): <description> format
Integrates GitLeaks pre-commit hook to scan staged diffs for leaked secrets
Blocks git commit execution immediately if an unredacted secret token is detected
